While this map helps separate the silhouette of the wearer's upper body and arms from the textured grass background, its semantic labels and masks are highly unreliable under this steep egocentric viewpoint. Specifically, it misclassifies the lawnmower's deck and grass bag as a 'person' in frames 1 and 5 and as a 'parking meter' in frames 2 and 3, completely misses the mower in frame 4, and mislabels the right concrete sidewalk in frame 3 as a 'surfboard'. pose: The pose map tracks the 2D skeletal locations of the camera wearer's right and left hands (magenta) gripping the lawnmower handlebar out of arm's reach at roughly 3–5 m in front of and below the camera, while confirming no other people are present or facing away from the wearer.
